system.description:
Skill: Performance

Exploit Type: Skilled Exploit

You quickly assume the appearance of someone you've studied. As an Action, you can make a Performance check contested by the Insight of any creature observing you.

On a success, you perfectly imitate the voice, posture, and appearance of a humanoid creature you have interacted with personally for at least 10 minutes.

While disguised this way, casual observers do not suspect anything is amiss. If a creature becomes suspicious, you have advantage on Deception checks made to maintain the illusion. This disguise lasts for up to 1 hour, or until you choose to end it (no action required).

You cannot duplicate traits (like Kekkei Genkai or chakra signature), and this disguise does not fool jutsu-based sensory abilities or effects that detect transformation.
